svg.title: Problem 7: SIXT + TUM challenge architecture
svg.desc: Two stages each provide 25 CSV files and 200 questions. Teams calculate answers and submit CSVs, methods and a presentation. Automatic dataset grading contributes 65 points, judging contributes 35, and verified small-model use adds 15 bonus points. Maximum 115.
svg.text: From company data to trustworthy answers
Calculate answers from fictional company data, explain your method, and submit your answer CSVs.
Use a framework or your own code.
and show evidence of your results.
Qualifying models: at most 40B total parameters.
Eligibility is verified from your model evidence.
Inside the dataset score: 35% public accuracy + 65% final accuracy. See the marking scheme for the full formula.
400 scored questions + 10 practice examples. CSV = a spreadsheet-style table saved as a text file.
13 Nov 2026 (CET): Stage 1 at 09:30; Stage 2 and public lock at 14:45; all final work due at 16:45.
